newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH jumps at the open, outperforms.
newsitem.headline: LVMH jumps at the open, outperforms.

text.p: Shares in LVMH were up nearly four percent on Wednesday, rising nearly twice the rate of increase of the CAC-40 index, after recouping Tuesday's loss following the group's fresh forays into the capital of Grand Metropolitan
Its stock was up 4.11 percent at 1,623 francs at 0820 GMT while the CAC-40 index was 2.6 percent higher.
LVMH said on Tuesday that it bought shares in Grand Met and sold shares in Guinness. Its current holdings should be made public today after being registered with Britain's Takeover Panel.

Brokerage Ferri said in its market comment that sources estimated LVMH held 10 to 12 percent of GrandMet. "It has thus spent 4.7 billion francs. The money would come from Guinness sales -- we estimate four percent of Guinness may have been sold. Bernard Arnault's strategy is thus to hold 10 percent of Guinness and 10 percent of GrandMet a level which permits him to call extraordinary general meetings under British law," it said.
